others.route: Residence permit on the basis of work (Finnish Immigration Service)

note: Finland: EEA and Swiss nationals live and work freely (the eea list). Everyone else coming to work applies to the Finnish Immigration Service for a residence permit on the basis of work. The Aliens Act's work without a residence permit for invited professional artists couldn't be read: migri.fi answers this client with a bot challenge and Finlex's translation needs a script; not modelled.
